purpose: Twenty additional evaluation requests for the completed v1.6 palette. IDs continue the earlier 25-case set. Do not add these requests to the intent training corpus before evaluating them. No audio was generated when writing this fixture.

cases.title: Soulful Sunday dancefloor
cases.prompt: A warm Sunday dancefloor groove with rich Hammond organ chords, plucked electric bass, tambourine and a steady kick. Add one brief, quiet female spoken hook near the drop: Stay a little longer. Keep the organ and bass in front.
cases.review: Check whether soulful dance context selects a suitable house family without requiring an explicit genre name.

cases.title: Clavinet tech house
cases.prompt: Minimal tech house at 126 BPM in A minor, with clipped clavinet chords, a bouncy bassline, dry 909 kit, rimshots and open hats. No piano, no lead melody, no vocals.

cases.title: FM bassline pressure
cases.prompt: UK bassline at 138 BPM in F minor, with short rubbery FM bass responses, shuffled hats and punchy claps. Keep the bass rhythmic rather than continuously held. No piano or vocals.

cases.title: Marimba UK funky
cases.prompt: UK funky at 130 BPM with marimba chords, interlocking congas and agogo, pushed percussion and a 3 against 2 polyrhythm. Keep the bass warm and the groove playful. Instrumental only.

cases.title: Reese jungle breaks
cases.prompt: 1990s jungle at 166 BPM in G minor, with repeating broken drum phrases, ghost snares, ride cymbal and deep Reese bass answers. No piano or lead melody. Instrumental only.

cases.title: Jump-up bass answers
cases.prompt: Jump-up drum and bass at 175 BPM with short aggressive FM bass calls, answering gaps, punchy snares and an 808 kit. Sparse chords, no long pads, no piano, no vocals.

cases.title: Neurofunk filter motion
cases.prompt: Neurofunk at 174 BPM in D minor, with dark moving growl bass, tight rolling drums and quiet atmospheric pads. Alternate bass phrases with breathing room. No piano or vocals.

cases.title: Minimal techno in five
cases.prompt: Minimal techno in 5/4 at 128 BPM, with sparse FM plucks, a clean sine sub, dry rimshots and a woodblock percussion cycle of 15 steps crossing bar lines. No vocals.
cases.review: The natural wording percussion cycle of 15 steps intentionally tests whether optional filler words are accepted.

cases.title: Dub techno space
cases.prompt: Dub techno at 124 BPM in C minor, with sparse delayed synth chords, warm sub-bass, open hats and long spaces between phrases. No piano, no arpeggios, no lead melody and no vocals.

cases.title: Resonant acid techno
cases.prompt: Acid techno at 136 BPM in F# minor, with resonant 303 bass, short slides, a driving 909 kit, open hats and occasional crash cymbals. No piano or acoustic guitar. Instrumental only.

cases.title: Intimate kalimba night groove
cases.prompt: An intimate late-night groove with delicate kalimba chords, plucked electric bass, soft drums and a laid-back snare. Add one brief, quiet female spoken hook near the drop: Stay here with me. Keep the rest instrumental.
cases.review: Evaluate alternative-R&B, soul or restrained downtempo fit without forcing one genre label.

cases.title: Memphis bells and 808
cases.prompt: Dark Memphis rap at 140 BPM in C minor, with a repeating bell riff, saturated 808 bass and triplet hats. No cowbells. Add one brief, quiet male spoken hook near the drop: Keep the night moving. Keep the rest instrumental.
cases.review: Verify both percussion cowbells and the melodic cowbell profile are absent.

cases.title: Cowbell phonk
cases.prompt: Phonk at 150 BPM in C minor, with a pitched melodic cowbell hook, distorted 808 bass and tight rolling hats. Keep the hook audible above the bass. No piano or vocals.

cases.title: Sparse gqom pressure
cases.prompt: Gqom at 126 BPM with ominous broken kick phrases, deep sine sub-bass and sparse woody percussion. Leave large gaps and almost no harmony. No piano, no lead, no arpeggios, no vocals.

cases.title: Private-school piano warmth
cases.prompt: Private-school piano at 112 BPM in D dorian, with lush Rhodes ninth chords, rounded resonant log-drum bass phrases and soft shakers. Keep the harmony warm and the percussion restrained. No vocals.
cases.review: Distinguish private-school piano from generic amapiano even when log-drum language appears.

cases.title: Percussive sgija
cases.prompt: Sgija at 114 BPM in D minor, focused on syncopated log-drum phrases, claps, shakers and call-and-response drums. No keys, no piano, no lead melody and no vocals.
cases.review: The log drum occupies the bass role and should survive the no-keys exclusion.

cases.title: Steelpan Caribbean courtyard
cases.prompt: A warm Caribbean courtyard party with a relaxed bouncing riddim, steelpan chords, bongos and deep rounded bass. Keep it spacious and easy to move to, with no piano or vocals.
cases.review: Allow plausible dancehall, dub or neighboring Caribbean interpretations; check the requested instruments independently.

cases.title: Reggaeton marimba and clave
cases.prompt: Reggaeton at 94 BPM in A minor, with marimba chords, bongos and a 2-3 son clave beneath a steady dance groove. Keep the lead sparse. No piano or vocals.
cases.review: Verify two-bar clave direction separately from the core drum pattern.

cases.title: Dominican dembow percussion
cases.prompt: Dominican dembow at 118 BPM, with short kalimba accents, punchy bass, rimshots and tambourine. Make the percussion busy but the melody sparse. No congas, no claps and no vocals.
cases.review: Distinguish the dembow preset from reggaeton and verify the individual percussion exclusions.

cases.title: Progressive trance release
cases.prompt: Progressive trance at 132 BPM in E minor, with wide sustained pads, an energetic lead synth melody, bright arpeggios and an eight-bar build into the drop. Add one brief, quiet robotic spoken hook at the drop: Into the light. Keep the build instrumental.
cases.review: Check that the build spans bars 12–19 and that vocal scheduling follows the actual section boundaries.

vocalPolicy: 16 instrumentals; four optional quiet spoken hooks, restricted to one phrase opportunity at the drop, no chops or stutters. No audio generated.
